fusions.name: Panic Wave
fusions.desc: You burst into every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage and knocking them back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Run-Down
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. You run it down from up to 6 tiles away and bite for 22 damage, up to 1.5 times as much from full range.

fusions.name: Startled Bolt
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% and your dodge chance by 8% for 6 seconds, and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Noticed First
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 8 stamina. Once every 6 seconds. Against an enemy that has not yet been wounded, your critical hit chance is 30% higher.
